input: Compile a family emergency contact binder

gold.taskTitle: Compile a Family Emergency Contact Binder
gold.taskDescription: Gather, organize, and assemble all essential emergency contacts and critical family information into a single physical or digital binder.

questions.title: Will this binder be physical, digital, or both?
questions.description: Understand the format the user wants for the final binder.

questions.title: Which family members are included in this binder?
questions.description: Identify whose information needs to be collected and represented.

questions.title: What types of contacts must be included?
questions.description: Clarify whether this covers doctors, schools, neighbors, utility companies, insurers, or other categories.

questions.title: Should it include critical documents like insurance cards or IDs?
questions.description: Determine if photocopies or scans of key documents need to be part of the binder.

questions.title: Is there a specific emergency scenario this binder is designed for?
questions.description: Find out if the focus is on natural disasters, medical emergencies, general safety, or all of the above.

questions.title: Who in the household needs access to this binder?
questions.description: Understand whether multiple copies are needed or if access by children or caregivers matters.

questions.title: Do you have a deadline or target date to finish this?
questions.description: Establish a timeline so the plan can be broken into realistic steps.
